question: Who is likely to start this fixture, appear, and play how many minutes?

recent_evidence.note: The latest five completed competitive matches are used. The immediately previous match has full recency weight; each older match retains 75% of the next-newer match's weight. Cross-competition evidence is discounted but remains usable.

shape.note: Up to three exact declared XIs vote on the tactical role shape. Player Alpha Ability is not part of the vote.

tuning.selected_on: mean exact-XI starter hits in the earlier chronological development sample

selection.note: The latest declared XI is the strongest manager-intent signal. The 15-minute persistence bonus won on the first 60% chronological development sample and is judged only on the untouched final 40%.

minutes.formula: P(start) * E(minutes | start) + (P(appear) - P(start)) * E(minutes | substitute)
minutes.note: Raw expectations remain visible. A separate capped allocation is normalized to 990 team minutes for downstream team aggregation.

decision_boundaries.activation_gate: Must improve chronological XI hit rate and expected-minutes MAE against the minutes-only v1 policy emulation before replacing v1.
